what: BRAF V600E is a substitution in the BRAF gene: the mutation of valine 600 to glutamic acid (V600E).
BRAF mutations are found to be recurrent in many cancer types, and of these, V600E is the most prevalent. V600E has been determined to be an activating mutation.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions BRAF V600E, it is recording a finding about this gene change. This page lists public FDA companion diagnostics that look for BRAF V600E, and the therapies and trials in this snapshot that use BRAF V600E as a selection criterion. That mention is not a diagnosis or a treatment decision on its own.

CIViC assertion 27 is early evidence about Vemurafenib (molecular profile KIAA1549::BRAF Fusion; disease Pilocytic Astrocytoma). CIViC’s summary is: Expression of the KIAA1549-BRAF fusion in pilocytic astrocytoma exhibits resistance to vemurafenib due to paradoxical activation of the MAPK pathway. The record lists evidence level TIER_II_LEVEL_D and status SUBMITTED. This is not an FDA approval.
